Secret Invasion episode 2 flashback (1997): young Gravik is among Talos's Skrull refugees who agree to Fury's deal to serve as his spy network; episode 6 tells his first mission for Fury. After Fury leaves Earth he breaks away and forms his own rebels at New Skrullos. 'Skrulls' is the group name the dataset uses for Talos's refugees.

owner_calls.question: Eyes of Wakanda episode 1 says Nkati was a former Wakandan Royal Guard captain as well as a War Dog (Hatut Zaraze). Should a past Royal Guard stage be added before Hatut Zaraze? The order of the two services, and whether 'Royal Guard' is the name said on screen, are unclear.
options: Keep as is (Hatut Zaraze, then Independent)
Add Wakandan Royal Guard before Hatut Zaraze, both keyed to Eyes of Wakanda
owner_calls.evidence: Akeya briefs Noni that Nkati was a former Royal Guard captain who fled with stolen vibranium; the Lion then reveals he was a War Dog sent out into the world.
